messages:
elaine: Heads-up: PR 1420 is ready for docs review. Adds a compact guide for function/tool calling + a minimal JSON schema example. Need quick QA on clarity, sdk parity (py/js), and a tiny parse-fallback snippet.

matt: I can take it this afternoon. Which runtime field names are used? We switched from "tools" to "invocations" last sprint.

elaine: Updated prose uses "invocations" but one example still showed "tools"  I fixed the sample in the branch. Schema uses nullable "meta" as discussed.

sam: Paste the schema so I can validate quickly? Teams tripped on required fields before.

elaine: Schema from PR: { "type": "object", "properties": { "command": {"type": "string"}, "args": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "meta": {"anyOf": [{"type": "object"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["ok","error"]} }, "required": ["command","status"] }

nina: Schema looks fine. Suggest one-line note: runtime may emit extra top-level keys; parsers should be defensive. Keep sample simple and put the recommendation in prose.

matt: Also add a two-line JS helper to normalize nullable meta so consumers don't repeat checks.

elaine: Added helper in the JS snippet: function normalizeMeta(obj){ return obj.meta == null ? {} : obj.meta; } const output = response.invocations?.[0]?.output || {}; const meta = normalizeMeta(output);

sam: For Python please use safe access: response.get("invocations", [])[0].get("output", {}) and mention KeyError avoidance.

elaine: Will add py example. Also adding a tiny parse-fallback pseudo-code: try json.loads(text) except ValueError: parsed = try_regex_extract(text)

doc-bot: PR 1420 markdown-lint: passed. link-check: 1 warning (old internal ticket link).

nina: I'll fix the broken link and re-run.

matt: +1 after link fix and tiny naming tweak in the prose.

sam: +1 for schema and helper.

elaine: Thanks all  will merge after nina's link patch and post a short changelog and snippet sandbox link. :rocket:
